race.comment: JENNI YOU THINK (12) has run third at her past three starts, off a let up into a 1400m run in town then closing off well behind a smart pair at Ballarat that dominated up on speed. Should be at peak fitness now and D Lane going aboard is a huge positive. Hard to hold out. CUSHIONED (11) presents third up, good at Cranbourne behind an in form horse last time out. Drops in weight for Willo and can improve again. KIWI JENNI (13) is racing consistently, back slightly in trip off a good run at Geelong. Hard to knock anything the Maher stable throw a saddle on at the moment.THE MUFFIN MAN (9) should be ready to fire third up and can roll forward from a wide gate. ITSUKUSHIMA (3) bounced back to form at Cranbourne and will give a sight up on speed.
